name: OneIG-Bench
intro: OneIG-Bench 是面向文生图模型的双语细粒度基准，包含动漫与风格、人像、通用物体、文本渲染、知识推理和多语种六个提示集合，并自动评测语义对齐、文本渲染、推理、风格和多样性。
build_method: 真实提示整理, 聚类平衡与语义去重, GPT-4o长度改写, 人工审核与中文翻译核验
metric: Semantic Alignment, Text Score, Reasoning Score, Style Score, Diversity Score
language: 英文, 中文, 多语言
eval_feature: 五维自动评测, 中英文对比, 提示类型与长度细分分析
scale: 2,440条提示记录：1,120条英文及其中文版本，另含200条多语种提示
build_method_en: Real-world Prompt Curation, Clustering and Semantic Deduplication, GPT-4o Length Rewriting, Manual Review and Verified Chinese Translation
eval_feature_en: Five-dimensional Automated Evaluation, English-Chinese Comparison, Prompt-type and Length Analysis
intro_en: OneIG-Bench is a bilingual fine-grained benchmark for text-to-image models. It contains six prompt sets for anime and stylization, portrait, general objects, text rendering, knowledge and reasoning, and multilingualism, and automatically evaluates semantic alignment, text rendering, reasoning, style, and diversity.
scale_en: 2,440 prompt records: 1,120 English prompts and their Chinese counterparts, plus 200 multilingual prompts
metric_en: Semantic Alignment, Text Score, Reasoning Score, Style Score, Diversity Score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.07977, the official OneIG-Bench project page, dataset, and evaluation code. The diagrams preserve five core evaluation dimensions; prompt curation from public internet data, user inputs, and established datasets; scene and semantic clustering, cosine-similarity deduplication, and subset balancing; GPT-4o rewriting into short, medium, and long prompts at about a 1:2:1 ratio; manual sensitive-content and semantic-conflict review; verified Chinese translation and 200 additional multilingual prompts; six prompt sets totaling 1,120 English and 1,320 Chinese records; category-based image generation; DSG question graphs with GPT-4o and Qwen2.5-VL-7B conditional leaf scoring; text edit distance, completion rate, and word accuracy; GPT-4o/LLM2CLIP reasoning, dual-encoder style similarity, DreamSim diversity, and bilingual fine-grained reporting.
